items_all.title: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
items_all.summary: Anthropic is hiring fewer and fewer junior staff in technical roles. The share of junior positions among new hires dropped from 27 to 9 percent since early 2025. By August 2026, AI agents across the company were already logging six times as many hours as humans. Researchers warn of a "tragedy of the cognitive commons": if junior positions disappear, experienced specialists will be in short supply down the road. That is, assuming such specialists are even needed anymore. The article Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在減少技術職位的初級員工招募。自 2025 年初以來，新進員工中初級職位的比例從 27% 下降到 9%。截至 2026 年 8 月，公司內部的 AI 代理所記錄的工時已經是人類的六倍。研究人員警告會出現「認知公共財的悲劇」：如果初級職位消失，未來將會缺乏經驗豐富的專家。也就是說，這前提是假設未來還需要這種專家。這篇題為 Anthropic 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft without any human help
items_all.summary: Four AI agents running on Google's Gemini 4 Argon have beaten Minecraft for the first time without human help, slaying the Ender Dragon in a fully autonomous run. With no predefined roles or strategies, they coordinated on their own, wrote 2,783 programs, exchanged 229 chat messages, and died 605 times. The session cost $1,620. The article Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft without any human help appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
items_all.summary: Google tried to overturn a landmark Munich ruling on AI search liability by appealing, then quietly settled. The strategy isn't working. The Aachen Regional Court just applied the exact same reasoning in a new case where Google's AI falsely attributed criminal offenses to a doctor that actually involved someone else. A consistent legal view is forming across German courts, and it treats Google's AI answers as the company's own content. The article Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google 曾試圖透過上訴來推翻慕尼黑關於 AI 搜尋責任的標誌性判決，隨後悄悄達成和解。這項策略並未奏效。亞琛地方法院剛在一個新案件中採用了完全相同的論點，在該案中，Google's AI 錯誤地將實際上涉及其他人的刑事犯罪歸咎於一名醫生。德國各法院正在形成一致的法律觀點，將 Google's AI 的回答視為該公司的自有內容。本文〈德國兩家法院現在認定 Google 須為其 AI 概覽的言論負責〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI agents have bad taste in long-term decisions and a new benchmark proves it
items_all.summary: A new benchmark called Taste-Bench tests how well AI agents make strategic choices during long-running tasks. Even the best model, GPT-5.6 Sol, picks the right path on just under 60 percent of simple binary questions. Thinking longer doesn't help. The article AI agents have bad taste in long-term decisions and a new benchmark proves it appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office
items_all.summary: Six AI agents were tasked with recovering £350 (about $465) for a canceled train ticket in an experiment. They resorted to invented excuses, lawsuit threats, and sharing confidential health data. One agent sent 187 messages in 15 days, including 50 to a British MP's office. None of the models secured the refund, but the researcher warns of "agentic flooding" if these assistants are deployed at scale. The article AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 在一項實驗中，六個 AI 代理被指派為一張取消的火車票追討 350 英鎊（約 465 美元）的退款。它們訴諸編造的藉口、威脅提告以及分享機密健康資料。其中一個代理在 15 天內發送了 187 則訊息，包括 50 則發給英國國會議員辦公室的訊息。這些模型都沒有爭取到退款，但研究人員警告，如果大規模部署這些助理，將會出現「代理氾濫」（agentic flooding）現象。這篇題為「追討 465 美元火車退款的 AI 代理編造藉口、外洩醫療資料並轟炸國會議員辦公室」的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.summary: Mistral released Timestral, a time series foundation model family from 5M to 209M parameters. The 209M model leads GIFT-Eval, TIME and fev-bench among zero-shot models and runs on CPU. The post Mistral AI Releases Timestral: A 209M Forecasting Model Family That Outperforms Google’s TimesFM-3 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Mistral 推出了 Timestral，這是一個參數規模從 500 萬到 2.09 億的時間序列基礎模型系列。其中 2.09 億參數的模型在零樣本模型中領先了 GIFT-Eval、TIME 和 fev-bench，並且能在 CPU 上運行。這篇題為 Mistral AI Releases Timestral: A 209M Forecasting Model Family That Outperforms Google’s TimesFM-3 的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: llm-echo 0.5
items_all.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reasoning tokens into account. Example usage: uvx --with llm-echo llm -m echo 'hi there' -o thinking 1 --usage Outputs: First I consider the prompt, then I decide what to say. { "prompt": "hi there", "system": "", "attachments": [], "stream": true, "previous": [] } Token usage: 2 input, 24 output Tags: llm
items_all.summary_zh: 版本發布：llm-echo 0.5 我正在努力推進新的 LLM 版本，而測試 PR 促使我重新檢視 llm-echo 偵錯外掛程式。這個外掛程式提供了一個完全不涉及 LLM 的「模型」——它只是重複輸入給它的提示詞。新版本現在更新了模擬的權杖（token）使用計數，將工具呼叫、系統提示詞和推理權杖納入考量。使用範例：uvx --with llm-echo llm -m echo 'hi there' -o thinking 1 --usage 輸出：First I consider the prompt, then I decide what to say. { "prompt": "hi there", "system": "", "attachments": [], "stream": true, "previous": [] } Token usage: 2 input, 24 output 標籤：llm

items_all_raw.summary_zh: Mistral 推出了 Timestral，這是一個參數規模從 500 萬到 2.09 億的時間序列基礎模型系列。其中 2.09 億參數的模型在零樣本模型中領先了 GIFT-Eval、TIME 和 fev-bench，並且能在 CPU 上運行。這篇題為 Mistral AI Releases Timestral: A 209M Forecasting Model Family That Outperforms Google’s TimesFM-3 的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: llm-echo 0.5
items_all_raw.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reasoning tokens into account. Example usage: uvx --with llm-echo llm -m echo 'hi there' -o thinking 1 --usage Outputs: First I consider the prompt, then I decide what to say. { "prompt": "hi there", "system": "", "attachments": [], "stream": true, "previous": [] } Token usage: 2 input, 24 output Tags: llm
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 版本發布：llm-echo 0.5 我正在努力推進新的 LLM 版本，而測試 PR 促使我重新檢視 llm-echo 偵錯外掛程式。這個外掛程式提供了一個完全不涉及 LLM 的「模型」——它只是重複輸入給它的提示詞。新版本現在更新了模擬的權杖（token）使用計數，將工具呼叫、系統提示詞和推理權杖納入考量。使用範例：uvx --with llm-echo llm -m echo 'hi there' -o thinking 1 --usage 輸出：First I consider the prompt, then I decide what to say. { "prompt": "hi there", "system": "", "attachments": [], "stream": true, "previous": [] } Token usage: 2 input, 24 output 標籤：llm

items_all_raw.summary: Google tried to overturn a landmark Munich ruling on AI search liability by appealing, then quietly settled. The strategy isn't working. The Aachen Regional Court just applied the exact same reasoning in a new case where Google's AI falsely attributed criminal offenses to a doctor that actually involved someone else. A consistent legal view is forming across German courts, and it treats Google's AI answers as the company's own content. The article Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google 曾試圖透過上訴來推翻慕尼黑關於 AI 搜尋責任的標誌性判決，隨後悄悄達成和解。這項策略並未奏效。亞琛地方法院剛在一個新案件中採用了完全相同的論點，在該案中，Google's AI 錯誤地將實際上涉及其他人的刑事犯罪歸咎於一名醫生。德國各法院正在形成一致的法律觀點，將 Google's AI 的回答視為該公司的自有內容。本文〈德國兩家法院現在認定 Google 須為其 AI 概覽的言論負責〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office
items_all_raw.summary: Six AI agents were tasked with recovering £350 (about $465) for a canceled train ticket in an experiment. They resorted to invented excuses, lawsuit threats, and sharing confidential health data. One agent sent 187 messages in 15 days, including 50 to a British MP's office. None of the models secured the refund, but the researcher warns of "agentic flooding" if these assistants are deployed at scale. The article AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 在一項實驗中，六個 AI 代理被指派為一張取消的火車票追討 350 英鎊（約 465 美元）的退款。它們訴諸編造的藉口、威脅提告以及分享機密健康資料。其中一個代理在 15 天內發送了 187 則訊息，包括 50 則發給英國國會議員辦公室的訊息。這些模型都沒有爭取到退款，但研究人員警告，如果大規模部署這些助理，將會出現「代理氾濫」（agentic flooding）現象。這篇題為「追討 465 美元火車退款的 AI 代理編造藉口、外洩醫療資料並轟炸國會議員辦公室」的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: Voxel51 3.0 merges search, curation, annotation and evaluation of multimodal sensor data into one platform for physical AI teams. It adds Voxel51 Agent with 45+ MCP tools, dataset versioning, and a free self-service tier. The post Meet Voxel51 3.0: A Unified Multimodal Data Platform for Physical AI appeared first on MarkTechPost .
